mainEntity.name: How can AEO help my dental practice rank locally?

acceptedAnswer.text: AEO significantly boosts local rankings by optimizing your content to answer location-specific patient queries directly. When a potential patient searches for 'emergency dentist near me' or 'affordable dental implants in Chicago,' AEO ensures your practice's relevant content is structured to be picked up by search engines for local answer boxes or knowledge panels. This involves optimizing your Google Business Profile and creating geographically targeted content that addresses local patient needs and common questions, making your practice the go-to local resource.
acceptedAnswer.description: AEO boosts local dental rankings by optimizing content and Google Business Profile to directly answer location-specific patient queries, making your practice a local resource.
